decisions.reason: The source concerns correcting the ESP32 breakout-header pitch in the integrated-board PDF; it does not change GPIO assignments or their validity.
The breakout-header pitch correction does not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal conditioning.
The source does not change the BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitance requirements.
The PDF correction for ESP32 breakout pitch does not affect the panel input connectors, controls, or GPIO mappings.
The source does not address the standalone USB power source, regulator capacity, powered load, or source-selection topology.
The ESP32 breakout-header documentation correction does not change current-monitoring devices, rails, channels, or measurement coverage.
Although breakout pitch has a physical-layout implication, the source does not change the candidate's board dimensions, mounting, connector placement, or other recorded mechanical-layout attributes.
The source does not change USB enumeration, programming behavior, or the USB-C programming interface.
The corrected ESP32 breakout-header pitch is separate from the interboard connector types, pinouts, and board power topology.
The source does not alter the panel power-button connector, its board placement, PWRON connection, or control behavior.
The breakout-header documentation correction does not modify the AXP2101 USB, battery, charging, VMID, or VSYS power-path requirements.
The source concerns the ESP32 breakout on the integrated board and does not change any sensor-board module connector or pinout requirement.
